title: Strategic Communication in Arts, Culture and Tourism Sectors
description: Focus on principles of intentional and ethical strategic communication and their practical application to the arts, cultural and tourism sectors. Topics may include: developing organizational mandates; maintaining effective internal communications; undertaking media, public and member relations; advocating to public officials; liaising with sponsors and funding bodies; and creating impactful promotional content across platforms.
notes: This is a Professional Communication course.
recommendations: To be taken in third or fourth year.
